# Vendored causal trading engine

These Python modules are copied from the project owner's `karhic/causal-trading-engine` repository, revision `08f16c264fdae660f044abbccf512532ba29d9d5`, on 12 October 2026.

The standalone Freeburg Docker build includes this small engine snapshot to avoid depending on a second repository, an SSH key, or private package registry. The source is retained verbatim in `causaltrader/`. Changes should be explicitly reconciled to its upstream repository. These modules are authored by the repository owner and distributed here under the repository-level MIT License (see `/LICENSE`).
